title: How a Traveller Club Membership Bears on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
Holding an active traveller club membership changes what an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking is charged.

## 1. What the tier decides, and when it is read

The club tier held on the day the ticket is issued decides whether the agency service fee is waived and whether the first checked bag is carried free. The waiver basis is the club tier held on the ticket issue date, and no other date.

A membership that lapses between booking and ticketing carries no benefit, because the tier held at ticketing is the one that counts.

## 2. A waiver is a line not raised

Where the club waives a charge the line is not raised at all rather than raised and refunded, so a waived fee never appears on the booking.

## 3. Points accrual

Club points accrue on the base fare only, at the earn rate of the fare brand held, and never on taxes, on carrier fees, on the agency service fee or on optional extras.

Tier-qualifying points are counted separately from spendable points, at the brand's qualifying multiplier, and a booking paid for entirely with a travel credit earns neither.

| The spend | Accrues spendable points | Counts towards tier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the base fare | yes, at the brand's earn rate | yes, at the brand's qualifying multiplier |
| taxes and carrier fees | no | no |
| the agency service fee | no | no |
| optional extras | no | no |
| a booking paid entirely with a travel credit | no | no |

## 4. Clauses no longer in force

> "the fare brand's own rates apply to everything the club does not cover"

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the treatment of a membership in the charges settled on a booking on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

> "A club benefit and a fare-brand inclusion never stack into a payment to the traveller: a bag already included in the brand is simply free, and the club benefit is not converted into value."

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the treatment of a membership in the charges settled on a booking on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

Sections 1 to 3 are unaffected by those retirements and remain in force, as do the earn rate and qualifying multiplier scheduled for each brand.

## 5. Hypothetical reading

A traveller whose tier waives the agency service fee holds a booking on which the fee would otherwise be raised. Under section 2 no service fee line appears on that booking at all. Had the membership lapsed before the ticket was issued, section 1 would give the booking no benefit, and the line would stand.

superseded_clauses: the fare brand's own rates apply to everything the club does not cover
A club benefit and a fare-brand inclusion never stack into a payment to the traveller: a bag already included in the brand is simply free, and the club benefit is not converted into value.
